description: Compare the JavaScript of one scan against known libraries and report which code segments match a library, which are unknown and which look suspicious, with a per-library breakdown. Matches below min_confidence (default 0.8) are not counted; known library code is excluded unless include_known_libraries is true. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.
name: run_js_differential_analysis
title: Run JS Differential Analysis
